headline: Conducting the Primary Election, and any complaints or challenges to the Primary Election.
summary: Members will be in session all day to conduct the Primary Election. They may also take up any complaints or challenges for the Primary Election, and votes may be taken.

Complaints or challenges for the Primary Election (votes may be taken)
